title: Real options and investment timing
reviewer: Independent equity and valuation specialist agent
scope: Full manuscript, four worked examples, all eight exact exercise prompts and solutions, answered teaching/retention, four lab assets, complete author checker, source proposals and author review. Reviewer changed no author or shared payload.
conceptual_audit: Real options are feasible dated rights and policies, with expiry, costs, financing and information specified. A fixed-policy NPV is not confused with a DCF that already incorporates contingent actions; the option premium is not added twice.

The market-price case explicitly supplies a traded operating clone, borrowing/lending, fractional/short trading, absence of intervening distributions and perfect terminal spanning. The solved state prices are positive, sum to the discount factor and reproduce the underlying price. Physical forecasts and the nonlinear option's expected return are kept separate from pricing weights.

Immediate construction with extra interim cash changes the package acquired immediately, while delayed construction misses that cash. Comparing the changed immediate package with the unchanged waiting claim correctly produces the switch threshold rather than granting free waiting.

The owner cases state a linear expected-money criterion and a time-preference discount rate. Their physical-probability values are not presented as identified market prices for unspanned private risks. Exercise 7 constructs two positive pricing measures consistent with the bond but no observed clone, demonstrating non-identification.

Operating decisions occur after observed demand. Expansion and abandonment are a mutually exclusive menu, and the low-demand sale is compared with the current continuation value rather than sunk initial cost. A binding cash limit removes infeasible expansion instead of assuming continuation value is pledgeable cash.

The pilot's cost is paid on every initial path. Successful and failed scale-up decisions occur after technical validation; forced completion is a controlled comparison with the same required pilot, probabilities and terminal receipts. Stop value is the discounted avoided failure-state outlay.

Information is compared with the best feasible no-report action at the same launch date. Bayes posteriors, likelihoods and signal probabilities are distinguished. Joint signal/state policy enumeration confirms that the imperfect report never grants true-state foresight. Information fees enter at date 0 and utility units are not treated as money under nonlinear preferences.

Nonnegative gross information value and the perfect-information bound require unchanged action set, dates, opportunity and free information that may be ignored. The manuscript explicitly states these qualifications and does not assert that all uncertainty raises firm value.

All exercise methods are introduced locally or referenced to accepted prerequisites. Open information-timing and business-evidence questions have evaluation criteria rather than fabricated determinate answers. All cases use original fictional amounts and separate proposals; they are not added into a company valuation.

resolved_findings.finding: The initial traded-clone lab accepted physical_up equal to zero or one despite its both-states-possible contract and strictly positive market state prices.
resolved_findings.author_resolution: Added 0 < physical_up < 1 only to the traded market case, documented it in the guide and added both endpoint rejection checks. Owner probabilities and signal likelihoods retain their valid closed-unit-interval boundaries.
resolved_findings.peer_verification: Read the final code/guide/checker/author changes and independently tested both endpoint rejections plus valid owner certainty and unreachable signals. Original manuscript and reference numerical output are unchanged.

limits: This is an independent agent review, not external human academic certification or a guarantee of error-free work.

The audit establishes internal consistency of stipulated fictional rights, payoffs, market completeness and owner criteria. It does not establish actual legal rights, liquidity, funding access or a real project's spanning relation.
Primary-source inspection is limited to the stated method passages; no full-source factual endorsement or current market claim is made.
No browser, mobile or print visual QA is claimed. Coordinator retains shared build, sequential acceptance and publication responsibility.
